fact: Since October 2018 the NIF equals the Bilhete de Identidade number, and from the second half of 2023 AGT has run a mass ex officio update of its taxpayer database from civil ID records, reaching 10,849,787 individual taxpayers in January 2024.
title: Apenas 2 em cada 10 cidadãos têm oficialmente Número de Identificação Fiscal
